description: ScrollHeart song suggestions for background audio. All tracks are royalty-free or Creative Commons licensed. Organized by emotional mood.
usage_note: If the user provides a specific copyrighted song, use it as a REFERENCE for pacing and mood only. Suggest a royalty-free alternative from this list for the actual audio track. The scene pacing should still match the emotional arc of their chosen song.

audio_rules.format: MP3 at 128kbps (or Opus/AAC if browser support allows)
audio_rules.loading: preload='none' — only load after user clicks Begin
audio_rules.looping: Loop audio by default (loop attribute on audio element)
audio_rules.user_gesture: ALWAYS require explicit user click/tap before playing
audio_rules.fallback: If audio fails to load, degrade gracefully — the story works without sound

copyright_handling.user_names_copyrighted_song: Use it as MOOD REFERENCE only. Match the emotional arc (tempo, build, drop) in the scene pacing. Suggest a royalty-free alternative for actual audio.
copyright_handling.user_has_own_audio: They can place it in assets/music.mp3. Remind them about copyright if it's a commercial track.
copyright_handling.no_song_provided: Default to 'calm_dreamy' category suggestion based on relationship stage and color preference.
